text:
sam_devex: Heads-up — hitting a weird edge with the Node SDK when both PRIVATE_BASE_URL and HTTP_PROXY are set. Streaming connect succeeds but first reconnect after a short network hiccup returns 401 and the stream dies.

maya_eng: Is that when using mTLS to the private endpoint or just token auth through the proxy?

sam_devex: mTLS to the private endpoint (customer-managed certs) + standard Authorization header for the control plane. If I unset HTTP_PROXY it works fine.

leo_sre: Could be the proxy striping the Authorization on reconnect/redirect. Node http(s) libs sometimes drop headers for redirects unless you preserve them.

evan_sdk: Do we do any redirect/host-rewrite when falling back? Also what version of the SDK?

sam_devex: SDK v1.8.2. No intentional redirects but our runtime does connection handover: if private endpoint connection fails mid-stream we try proxy fallback for short bursts. The logs show 101 upgrade then after reconnect attempt a 401 from the private endpoint.

maya_eng: Can you paste the debug snippet from the client logs? Any TLS handshake failures?

sam_devex: sure — trimmed logs:

```
[INFO] websocket open -> 101
[WARN] connection reset, attempting reconnect (useProxy=true)
[DEBUG] proxy CONNECT /v1/stream 200
[DEBUG] auth header present: "Bearer xxxxxx"
[INFO] websocket re-open -> 101
[ERROR] auth error: 401 unauthorized from private-host.internal
```

leo_sre: Hmm proxy responded 200 on CONNECT but private-host returned 401. That suggests the proxy is forwarding the CONNECT to the private endpoint but the mTLS client cert isn't presented on the second handshake (maybe because proxy terminates TLS on CONNECT?).

evan_sdk: On Node we use `agent: new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true })` — keepAlive can cause socket reuse across different hostnames if misconfigured. Also some proxy libs don't pass client certificates through a CONNECT tunnel by default.

maya_eng: Quick checklist: 1) confirm SDK is picking the direct base URL when PRIVATE_BASE_URL is set (should prefer direct over proxy when host matches) 2) ensure reconnect flow reestablishes mTLS certs (client certs must be reattached to new TLS handshake) 3) don't drop Authorization on reconnects/redirects.

sam_devex: Thanks. Reproduced locally and added node --trace-warnings logging. Looks like our reconnect path was reusing the proxy agent without re-binding the client cert.

evan_sdk: Two quick mitigations we can do in SDK: 1) when PRIVATE_BASE_URL is present, bypass proxy for that host by default (e.g. respect NO_PROXY-like behavior) 2) on reconnect, always create a fresh https.Agent for mTLS flows so certs get attached.

leo_sre: Also add a guard so Authorization header is explicitly forwarded on reconnect/redirect unless the host changes. Node's `follow-redirects` or fetch libs need header preservation.

maya_eng: I can draft a small test matrix: combine envs (PRIVATE_BASE_URL, HTTP_PROXY, NO_PROXY) x auth modes (token, mTLS) x streaming reconnect and validate behavior.

sam_devex: Nice. Action items: @evan_sdk will open a PR to 1) bypass proxy for private host when PRIVATE_BASE_URL set, 2) use fresh https.Agent for reconnects when mTLS enabled, 3) add header-preserve on redirect/reconnect. @maya_eng will add CI test cases for the matrix above. I'll validate customer repro after the patch.

evan_sdk: Will do. I’ll also add a small debug log if we ever detect a CONNECT+401 combo so customers can triage.

ci-bot: created issue #4521: "node sdk: proxy/mTLS reconnect -> 401 on private endpoint" and attached label "devex/bug" :thumbsup:

sam_devex: thanks all, ping me in PR for quick review. :pray:
